title: Credit for a Late Decision on a Standard Non-Formulary Exception (Formulary Benefit)
content:
**Credit clause.** Under the Formulary Benefit, a late-decision credit is added to a standard non-formulary exception approval when the decision is made after it fell due.

**Due date.** The due date is the date of the latest supporting statement for the drug plus the formulary's standard decision time. That time is the formulary's standard decision hours divided by twenty-four, which is **72** hours, or 3 days, on every Northbridge formulary.

**Days late.** The days from the statement date to the decision date, less those 3 days.

| Days late | Credit added |
|---|---|
| at least **7** (the late week) | **2** months |
| at least 1 but fewer than 7 | **1** month |
| fewer than 1 | nothing |

The credit is added to the approval period before the floor of one month is applied.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical statement received 1 April, due 4 April)

| Decision date | Days late | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 4 April | 0 | nothing |
| 5 April | 1 | 1 month |
| 10 April | 6 | 1 month |
| 11 April | 7 | 2 months |
